## How I approach data work

I like engineering the part between a promising idea and a system people can rely on. That means asking how data gets in, how its quality is checked, how a model or downstream team will use it, and how we will know when something needs attention.

My experience has moved between Azure and AWS, large-scale Spark pipelines, and Java services. In each setting, I’ve focused on modular designs, practical automation, and making data workflows easier to operate.

### Software Engineer 2, Big Data

Worked across data platforms, ML operations, and streaming analytics.

**Datacore (DNA)**

Built and maintained Azure Data Factory pipelines for ingestion and transformation, storing data in ADLS as Parquet and replicating it to PostgreSQL. Optimized analytics workflows with Databricks and Control-M, and designed modular pipelines for new sources and requirements.

**ML operations**

Designed AWS data pipelines for model onboarding in fraud detection and account-takeover prevention. Defined onboarding rules, model metrics, and performance tracking, and created QuickSight dashboards for training data and model outputs.

**ONE Analytics**

Built Scala and Spark pipelines integrating Salesforce, SFTP, and Kafka data into Hive and PostgreSQL. Designed centralized pipeline observability through JFrog and integrated PagerDuty and Grafana for alerts and job tracking.
:::

### Software Engineer

**Data platform migration**

Worked with product managers to redesign data pipelines and migrate data flows from Informatica to Azure, contributing to **$1M in operational cost savings**. Built data scripts, CI/CD pipelines, and data-quality controls with Azure Data Factory, SQL Server, ADLS, Docker, Jenkins, Ansible, and Kubernetes.

**Data warehouse and quality monitoring**

Designed an AWS Redshift warehouse for structured and semi-structured data and automated processing with Apache Airflow. Developed data-quality monitoring with AWS Glue and CloudWatch to detect missing data, outliers, and schema changes.

### Software Engineering Associate

**Order orchestration**

Designed Java/J2EE services with Spring Cloud, OAuth 2.0, and JWT, and built REST APIs with Spring Boot. Containerized services with Docker and Kubernetes and optimized Jenkins CI/CD. AWS serverless workflows reduced deployment time by **40%**.

**Testing and environment visibility**

Used JUnit and Mockito to raise conditional code coverage from **45% to 60%** and improve efficiency by **18%**. Also built REST APIs and dashboards to show the status of **50 production and non-production environments**, helping teams see resource availability in real time.

**Cloud-native order processing**

Developed Spring Boot services and integrated Amazon API Gateway, EC2, S3, and RDS with MySQL for order processing and data storage.
